OVERVIEW.TITLE: Kanban
OVERVIEW.SUBTITLE: Visualize and manage work across funnels, stages, and tasks.
OVERVIEW.EMPTY_DESCRIPTION: Funnels organize your team's work into stages. Create your first one to start tracking tasks and conversations on the board.

BOARD.NO_STAGES_DESCRIPTION: Add stages from settings to start placing tasks on the board.

SWIMLANES.TITLE: Group by
SWIMLANES.LABEL: Label
SWIMLANES.EMPTY: No tasks match the current swimlanes.

SETTINGS.TITLE: {name} — Settings
SETTINGS.SUBTITLE: Configure stages, audience, automations and danger zone.
SETTINGS.STAGES_SUBTITLE: Drag to reorder. Each stage can be active, won, or lost.
SETTINGS.STAGES_EMPTY: No stages yet. Add the first one to start.
SETTINGS.DANGER_SUBTITLE: Deleting a funnel removes all of its stages and tasks. This cannot be undone.
SETTINGS.AUTOMATIONS_SUBTITLE: Trigger automated actions — assign an agent, move the card, send a message — when a task is created, changes stage or goes overdue.

AUTOMATIONS.MODAL_SUBTITLE: Pick the trigger, narrow it with conditions, then stack the actions that should run when the rule fires.
AUTOMATIONS.EMPTY: No automations yet. Pair a trigger with an action chain so the team never has to do it by hand.
AUTOMATIONS.DELETE_CONFIRM_MESSAGE: This cannot be undone. The automation

TASK_CREATED.LABEL: Task created
TASK_CREATED.DESC: Fires when a new task enters the funnel.

TASK_MOVED_TO_STAGE.LABEL: Task changes stage
TASK_MOVED_TO_STAGE.DESC: Fires every time a task moves to a different column.

TASK_MOVED_TO_FUNNEL.LABEL: Task changes funnel
TASK_MOVED_TO_FUNNEL.DESC: Fires when a task is moved into another funnel.

TASK_ASSIGNED.LABEL: Task assigned
TASK_ASSIGNED.DESC: Fires when someone is set as owner of the task.

TASK_PRIORITY_CHANGED.LABEL: Priority changed
TASK_PRIORITY_CHANGED.DESC: Fires when the urgency of a task changes.

TASK_COMPLETED.LABEL: Task completed
TASK_COMPLETED.DESC: Fires when a task is marked won or lost.

TASK_OVERDUE.LABEL: Task overdue
TASK_OVERDUE.DESC: Fires when the due date passes and the task is still open.

CONVERSATION_ATTACHED.LABEL: Conversation attached
CONVERSATION_ATTACHED.DESC: Fires when a conversation is linked to a task.

ASSIGN_USER.LABEL: Assign agent
ASSIGN_USER.DESC: Pick the agent who should own the task.

UNASSIGN_USERS.LABEL: Remove assignees
UNASSIGN_USERS.DESC: Clears every owner from the task. No parameters.

MOVE_TO_STAGE.LABEL: Move to stage
MOVE_TO_STAGE.DESC: Pick the destination stage inside this funnel.

SET_PRIORITY.LABEL: Set priority
SET_PRIORITY.DESC: Bumps the task urgency to the chosen level.

SET_DUE_DATE.LABEL: Set due date
SET_DUE_DATE.DESC: Sets the due date X days from the firing.

ADD_LABEL.LABEL: Add label
ADD_LABEL.DESC: Adds a named label to the task.

REMOVE_LABEL.LABEL: Remove label
REMOVE_LABEL.DESC: Removes a label from the task, if it's there.

ADD_SUBTASK.LABEL: Add subtask
ADD_SUBTASK.DESC: Creates a subtask with the given title.

SEND_MESSAGE.LABEL: Send message
SEND_MESSAGE.DESC: Sends a message on the conversation tied to the task.

WEBHOOK.LABEL: Fire webhook
WEBHOOK.DESC: POSTs the task payload to the URL.

RESOLVE_CONVERSATION.LABEL: Resolve conversation
RESOLVE_CONVERSATION.DESC: Marks the attached conversation as resolved. No parameters.

FORM.ACTIVE_HINT: When off, the rule is saved but never fires.
FORM.NAME_PLACEHOLDER: e.g. Auto-assign Naiara on hot leads
FORM.EVENT_HINT: Pick the trigger that runs the rule.
FORM.CONDITIONS_HINT: Only apply the rule when these conditions hold.
FORM.ACTIONS_HINT: They run top to bottom. With no actions the rule does nothing.
FORM.ACTIONS_EMPTY: Add at least one action to activate the automation.

FUNNEL.DESCRIPTION: Funnels organize tasks by stages and apply automations to conversations.
FUNNEL.DELETE_CONFIRM_MESSAGE: This will permanently remove the funnel, its stages and tasks. Confirm by typing the funnel name:

AUTO_CREATE_TASK_FOR_NEW_CONVERSATION.LABEL: Auto-create task for new conversations
AUTO_CREATE_TASK_FOR_NEW_CONVERSATION.HINT: When a conversation arrives in a linked inbox, create a task in the first stage.

AUTO_ASSIGN_TASK_TO_AGENT.LABEL: Auto-assign task to conversation agent
AUTO_ASSIGN_TASK_TO_AGENT.HINT: Tasks inherit the agent assigned to the linked conversation.

SYNC_TASK_CONVERSATION_ASSIGNEES.LABEL: Keep task and conversation assignees in sync
SYNC_TASK_CONVERSATION_ASSIGNEES.HINT: Assignee changes on either side propagate automatically.

AUTO_RESOLVE_CONVERSATION_ON_TASK_CLOSE.LABEL: Resolve conversation when task moves to won/lost
AUTO_RESOLVE_CONVERSATION_ON_TASK_CLOSE.HINT: Closing a task closes its linked conversations.

AUTO_WIN_TASK_ON_CONVERSATION_RESOLVE.LABEL: Move task to first won stage on conversation resolve
AUTO_WIN_TASK_ON_CONVERSATION_RESOLVE.HINT: Resolving a conversation moves its task to the first won stage.

NOTIFY_ON_TASK_STAGE_CHANGE.LABEL: Post activity on conversation when task changes stage
NOTIFY_ON_TASK_STAGE_CHANGE.HINT: Each stage change appends an activity message to the linked conversations — handy for an audit trail.

TAG_CONVERSATION_WITH_STAGE.LABEL: Tag conversation with current stage
TAG_CONVERSATION_WITH_STAGE.HINT: Applies a "kanban-<stage>" label to the conversation and removes the previous one so only the current stage tag sticks.

STAGE.DESCRIPTION: Stages segment tasks by status. Mark a stage as won or lost to close tasks.
STAGE.DELETE_CONFIRM_MESSAGE: All tasks must be moved before deleting. Confirm the stage to remove:

FORM.WIP_LIMIT_HINT: Visual warning when the stage goes over this count. Keeps the team focused.

TASK.DESCRIPTION: Tasks track work through your funnel. Assign, label and link to conversations.

FORM.STAGE_EMPTY_HINT: Go to Kanban → funnel settings to add stages before creating tasks.
FORM.CONTACT_SEARCH_PLACEHOLDER: Search contact by name, email or phone…

TASK.LINK_DESCRIPTION: Pick a task to attach to this conversation.
TASK.LINK_NO_TASKS: No tasks available in this funnel.
TASK.CONVERSATION_EMPTY: No tasks linked to this conversation yet.
TASK.NO_FUNNELS: Create a funnel first to add tasks.

COLUMN.EMPTY: Drag tasks here or add a new one.

CUSTOM_FIELDS.TITLE: Custom fields
CUSTOM_FIELDS.SUBTITLE: Add extra fields (text, number, date, select) that show up on every task of this funnel.
CUSTOM_FIELDS.EMPTY: No fields yet. Add the first one to start.
CUSTOM_FIELDS.DESCRIPTION: Custom fields appear in the task form for this funnel.
CUSTOM_FIELDS.DELETE_CONFIRM_MESSAGE: Filled values will be removed from every task. This cannot be undone.

FORM.REQUIRED_LABEL: Make required when creating a task

VIEWS.LABEL: Views
VIEWS.TITLE: Saved views
VIEWS.EMPTY: No saved views yet. Set up filters and save your first one.
VIEWS.NEEDS_FILTER: Apply at least one filter to save a view.

BULK.LABEL: Bulk actions
BULK.DELETE_CONFIRM_MESSAGE: You're about to delete {count} task(s). This cannot be undone.
